---
applyTo: "**/*.stl, **/*.3mf, **/*.png"
---

# Generated and binary product assets

- Do not edit binary assets as text.
- Keep STL files in `export/stl`, 3MF files in `package`, and renders in `preview`.
- Regenerate `assets.yaml` after an asset changes.
- Preserve millimeter scale and component naming.
- Do not alter immutable release assets in place.
